This console binary was built without its screens

It embeds packages/console/ui/dist, which in a checkout holds only this placeholder. Build the screens and copy them in from the repository root, then rebuild the binary: 

pnpm --filter @better-giving/console-ui build
rm -rf packages/console/ui/dist
cp -R packages/console-ui/build/client packages/console/ui/dist
cd packages/console
go build ./cmd/better-giving

git checkout packages/console/ui/dist puts this placeholder back afterwards. To work on the screens themselves, run pnpm console, which serves them from vite.
